race.comment: ROYSTON (9) is yet to fill a placing in 14 starts which is alarming but his latest effort, a close fourth over 1600m at Coffs Harbour, was a promising sign. Should race a lot closer today from the inside gate with blinkers on for the first time. Will never get a better chance to make his mark. HEY KALUMBA (2) made it three minor placings in a row when he led for home but found one a little better over 1400m at Armidale 12 days ago. Racing well five runs into the maiden campaign. New to this trip but if he gets a soft lead as expected he may prove tough to catch. HIGHLAND LAD (7) defied the market to finish third when fresh from a spell over 1460m at Queanbeyan last time out. Placed at his only try at this distance. Fitter and looks a serious contender. PRINCE OF WANTS (4) has showed positive signs at his last couple of runs and with blinkers on today might be ready to show his best. REEL PATIENCE (1) ran a nice race over this trip at the Gold Coast recently. Plenty more to come.
